sloka: हयैरन्ये गजैरन्ये रथैरन्ये स्वलङ्कृतै: ।सुकुमारास्तथैवान्ये पद्भिरेव नरा ययु: ॥ २.१०२.३७॥
transliteration: hayairanye gajairanye rathairanye svalaṅkṛtai: ।sukumārāstathaivānye padbhireva narā yayu: ॥ 2.102.37॥

translations.english: Some rode horses, some, elephants, while others mounted welldecorated chariots, while the young went on foot.
